The Ollama API endpoint extended in release 0.34.3 to advertise each model's thinking controls and default is `GET /api/show`. This is specified in the context provided:

- "GET /api/show now advertises each model's thinking controls and default."

This endpoint can be used with the command:

```
ollama show gemma4
```

And also via an API call:

```sh
curl http://localhost:11434/api/show -d '{"model": "glm-5.3-flash:cloud"}'
```
